findings.summary: crates/athena-cli/src/main.rs is not among the reading's deliverables
findings.evidence: A change outside the listed deliverables widens the scope.

findings.summary: With the advisory cut-off, a change that leaves more than 6 genuinely stale restatements passes, and the producer never sees the list.
findings.evidence: The request says to 'Fail the check and name each place that still says the old thing' and to give the producer the list inside its loop. Under the plan, a value needle with 7 or more hits only prints at most 5 `stale text  note:` UI lines. Nothing reaches the producer's brief, so a widely restated limit is never fixed, even when every hit is real. The value rule now requires prose with the value next to a name word, so it is already much stricter than in round 2. That makes the cut-off a blunt second filter. Fix: Whenever a send-back happens for another reason, put the advisory hits in the brief as a 'check these' list (and also when it is the only finding, if a wasted pass is acceptable). Otherwise apply the cut-off per file or per directory, not per needle. State in D190's Tradeoff that 7 or more real stale places are not enforced.
findings.location: Decision 3 (FIRM_VALUE_HITS = 6, advisory hits 'never put in the brief and never closing'); Decision 6 ADVISORY ONLY exit

findings.summary: The new unit-test fixture and D190's text repeat real constant names and values, so they will themselves be flagged when that constant really changes.
findings.evidence: The fixture string `/// A cause recorded in 3 or more distinct jobs is raised to urgent for the plan.` will sit in crates/athena-core/src/run/stale_text.rs. It meets every part of the value rule for REPEAT_URGENT_JOBS (plan.rs:471): the old value 3 is within 4 words of 'jobs', and 'urgent' is on the same line. It is a plain run inside a string literal, and it does not hold the new value. A future job that raises REPEAT_URGENT_JOBS would get a firm hit in this test file, and a job limited to other paths would then fail at the candidate. Fix: Keep the shape of the test (a 3-word name, single-digit value, common words) but use a made-up name, such as `REPEAT_URGENT_WIDGETS` with matching fixture words. Keep real constant names and values out of D190's prose examples.
findings.location: Demonstration for criterion 1, test (2) `a_repeat_urgent_jobs_change_leaves_unrelated_3_jobs_lines_quiet`; Decision 8 Tradeoff text ('MAX_JOBS 3 to 4')

findings.summary: A string constant whose old value contains punctuation can never produce a value hit.
findings.evidence: Rule (c) requires the old value and a keyword to stand in one plain-word run. Any character outside letters, digits, spaces, commas, hyphens and apostrophes ends a run. An old string value such as `athena/records` or `v1.2` contains such a character, so it can never be inside a run, and the rule silently drops it. Fix: Treat a string value as one token for rule (c), so a run can pass across it, or limit string needles to values made only of plain-run characters. Name the gap in D190's Tradeoff, and add a unit test for a string constant that contains punctuation.
findings.location: Decision 2 (1) ('one string of at least 3 characters') and Decision 3 (c) (plain-word run excludes '/', '.', ':', '_' and others)

summary: Round 3 fixes both round 2 majors. F2 (value false positives): a value hit now needs prose, meaning a plain-word run with the old value within 4 words of a word from the constant's name. A single digit needs two name words. Any value with more than 6 hits is advisory only. A test now uses the real REPEAT_URGENT_JOBS 3 to 4 shape. F3 (loose reading forms): `from A to B` now takes only numbers or quoted strings, and a decision counts only when it is the object of a reversal verb. Both have quiet tests. The round 2 minors are handled too: the parser reason is corrected, the self-trip risk is replaced by a manual grep step, and the second tree build is accepted with a reason. I checked the hook points in the snapshot. producer_loop has the gate at producer.rs:498-502, the all-clear test at :545-556, the limit branch at :635-675 and the brief chain at :701-712. check_and_verify has the scope and gate blocks at mod.rs:1980-2020. `outside_allowed_paths` is `pub(crate)` at mod.rs:1745, and PRODUCER_SEND_BACKS and SCOPE_SEND_BACKS are both 1. Every constant the help strings will read is `pub` and reachable from athena-cli, including RATING_RANGE through `pub use self::work::*` in records.rs:1116. The rest are minors. The advisory cut-off lets a change with 7 or more genuinely stale places pass without the producer ever seeing them. The unit-test fixture reuses the real REPEAT_URGENT_JOBS name, so it will become a stale place itself when that constant really changes. Edits to the main.rs help strings stay outside the deliverables list, which the plan's open question already raises.
